sentence: This project uses large-scale screening of gut bacterial extracts to find molecules that stop harmful bacteria and fungi.
This project builds a long-read sequencing test to settle unclear results from genetic testing.
This project studies how natural mutations in macrophage migration inhibitory factor affect systemic juvenile arthritis, using a mouse model.
This project builds imaging tools using magnetic resonance imaging at very high magnetic fields to study brain function and disease.
This project studies how regulatory T cells work and survive in the tumor microenvironment.
This project studies the genetic and environmental causes of psychiatric disorders using statistical and molecular genetics.
This project looks at genetic causes of cancer and at barriers to genetic counseling and testing among African Americans.
This project builds tools to track malaria spread in Zambia using mathematical modeling and machine learning.
This project studies how alcohol changes mitochondria in the liver and how this leads to alcohol-associated liver disease.
This project makes tools to map and count RNA on the surface of live cancer cells.
This project provides shared services that collect and store tissue samples and check them with molecular and immune tests.
This project tests whether transcranial direct current stimulation with naming treatment gives lasting improvement in naming ability in people with primary progressive aphasia.
This project studies how T cells and macrophages keep up harmful immune responses that cause rejection after lung transplant.
This project studies how mutations in splicing factors lead to blood diseases called myelodysplastic syndromes.
This project uses computed tomography scans and genetic and protein markers to track how pulmonary fibrosis gets worse.
This project builds a diffusion MRI method to see earlier whether cervical cancer is responding to radiation treatment.
This project studies which mutated peptides called neoantigens trigger T cell responses that destroy skin cancer tumors.
This project provides human tissue samples and single-cell and spatial tests of RNA and protein to support other research projects.
This project studies how antibodies against the N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor link autoimmune encephalitis to immune responses against breast cancer.
